skill.name: finance-summary
skill.description: Summarize financial data and generate reports.
skill.intent_routing:
1. SUMMARY (summarize, report, financial overview): - Determine the date range for the summary (e.g., "this month", "last quarter", "2025"). - Identify specific categories if requested. - Call `exec_sql` to query the expense ledger for relevant data. - Format the results into a human-readable summary or report. - Present the summary to the user.
2. HELP (help, what can you do): - Explain the capabilities of the finance-summary skill. - Provide examples of how to request a financial summary.
skill.tool_code: # Example SQL query for summarizing expenses by category for a given month # SELECT category, SUM(amount) FROM expenses WHERE date BETWEEN 'YYYY-MM-01' AND 'YYYY-MM-31' GROUP BY category;
skill.prohibited_actions: - Do not modify any financial data. This skill is read-only. - Do not expose sensitive financial details without explicit user permission.
